### UTC Date & Time

November 26, 2026, 14:00 UTC

### Agenda

- Glamsterdam:
  - Decide between:
    - https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5770
    - https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5820
    - 5770 now, 5820 later
  - Either set a Hoodi fork date in w/b 14 December (subject to ACDE confirmation) or postpone a decision
- Hegotá:
  - Discuss continued inclusion of FOCIL ([EIP-7805](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805)) as SFId headliner for Hegotá
    - Presentation from FOCIL champions, @soispoke and @jihoonsong
    - Open discussion
- Misc
  - [Hash function choice for PQ](https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/11/24/pqai-1), @kevaundray
  - \[Time permitting] Potential changes to [EIP-8365](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8365) (Disallow new 0x00 validators) @barnabasbusa 

### Call Series

All Core Devs - Consensus
